GLOSSARY

6C Architecture

Conceptual industrial intelligence framework composed of six layers: Connection, Conversion, Cyber, Cognition, Configuration, and Consciousness.

API (Application Programming Interface)

A set of rules and protocols allowing software components to communicate with each other. In VITA, APIs are implemented with FastAPI and expose training and forecasting endpoints.

CRISP-DM

Cross-Industry Standard Process for Data Mining. A methodology that defines phases for analytics projects: Business Understanding, Data Understanding, Data Preparation, Modeling, Evaluation, and Deployment.

Dashboard

Interactive web interface (Streamlit-based) of VITA that allows users to explore forecasts, configure scenarios, and visualize performance metrics.

DataOps

Practices that focus on improving the communication, integration, and automation of data flows across the data lifecycle.

Dataset

Structured collection of historical records and exogenous variables used for training and testing forecasting models.

Exogenous Variables

External factors that influence the target variable. In VITA examples, economic indicators (e.g., SELIC, IPCA) or production orders.

Forecast

Predicted value generated by a model. VITA forecasts are saved in output_forecasts/.

Forecast Types

  • Validation – Backtest forecasts on the last 4 months of historical data (holdout set), used to evaluate model accuracy.

  • Validation+OS – Validation forecasts with outliers substituted before evaluation.

  • Production – Forecasts for the next 4 months after training on the full historical dataset.

  • Production+OS – Production forecasts with outliers substituted before forecasting.

  • Test – Dataset of the last 4 historical months with real demand values and forecasts for evaluation.

  • Future – Forecasts for the next 4 months without real demand (prediction horizon).

  • Variation – Different feature set combinations in model_input (e.g., cd, cd_po, cd_po_selic_ipca).

Inputs (Features)

  • cd – Customer Demand (historical demand, target variable).

  • po – Production Orders.

  • ipca – Brazilian inflation index (IPCA).

  • selic – Brazilian interest rate (SELIC).

  • model_input – Feature set used to train the model (e.g., cd_po_ipca).

  • forecast_ai – Predicted values generated by the model.

  • customer_demand – Real observed demand values.

  • forecast_deviation_abs – Absolute forecast error, usually expressed in %.

LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory)

A type of recurrent neural network designed to capture long-term dependencies in sequential data. Used for multivariate time series forecasting.

MLOps

Set of practices for deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production reliably and efficiently. Includes CI/CD, monitoring, retraining, and model versioning.

Module

Self-contained part of the platform codebase, usually corresponding to a functional unit (e.g., algorithms, services, dashboard).

Reservoir Computing (RC)

A recurrent neural network approach that leverages a randomly connected dynamic reservoir for efficient time series forecasting.

Scenario

A configuration that defines the target variable and exogenous inputs used in a forecasting task. Example: cd_po_selic_ipca indicates customer_demand as target with production_orders, SELIC, and IPCA as exogenous variables.

Service

A microservice implemented with FastAPI that provides functionalities such as data upload, training, and prediction.

VITA Platform

Visionary Industrial Technology Architecture. A modular ecosystem for data analysis, forecasting, and process optimization in industrial contexts.
